title: Security
description: Who can get in, and the record of everything that happened — including everything GOTCHA did.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

sessions.unavailable: We couldn't reach the identity provider, so we can't show your sessions. This doesn't mean you have none.
sessions.revokeOthers: {count, plural, one {Sign out the other device} other {Sign out all # other devices}}
sessions.idpDown: The identity provider didn't answer, so nothing was signed out. Try again shortly.
sessions.revokeFailed: That didn't sign out. Try again.
sessions.revokeUnconfirmed: We couldn't confirm that signed out. It may have worked — signing out again is safe either way.

logins.unavailable: We couldn't reach the identity provider, so we can't show recent sign-ins.

mfa.impliedByEveryone: Already required, because everyone must use it.
mfa.unavailable: We couldn't read your two-factor settings, so they aren't shown. This doesn't mean two-factor is off.

audit.unavailable: We can't read the activity log yet, so this list is not available. It isn't empty — we just can't show it.
audit.moreActions: More kinds of activity exist than shown here.
